method: Actual original Ruffle; read-only AVM1 display/Atom value observer and real pointer controls, unchanged original data and clocks

results.scope: Actual original settled display and original Atom scalar data: all visible plotted/shell/orbital/cell coordinates; all graph points and values; all 72 table configurations read without mutation; original pointer shell Z1…18, every original electron-configuration Z1…103 × both energy arrangements with energy toggle and automatic play/pause/wrap; every original graph Z selection; eight group toggles; all 26 affinity cell selections and every permitted 8×9 metal/nonmetal pair. Independent source check separately covers finite complete configurations/group masks/pairs. Not all pointer histories, random graph-layout branches or modern reference accuracy. Original display coordinates allow one twip (.05px).
